name: Thaddius
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/naxxramas/thaddius.md. HP is a clock: phase 1 (the wights, about 126 s) then phase 2 (306 s, Thaddius 6.5M, DBM's 300 s Berserk) with a 14 s jump in between (real 11.3 to 16.3 s, DBM). The room, platforms and camp positions are estimates from prose. PHASE 1, ONE ENTITY FOR TWO WIGHTS: Stalagg and Feugen sit on two platforms joined by Tesla Coils and are tanked apart; the engine has one boss, so the two wights are drawn as one target at one spot and share one HP bar. The tank spot alternates west and east of it, and Magnetic Pull (every 21 s, DBM; 6 phases of 21 s) is a real `teleportTankTo` plus `threatWipe`: you are thrown across, your new wight has an empty table, and you Taunt. Everything about the balance between the two (ranged on Stalagg, melee on Feugen, both must die within 5 s or the first resurrects, stop on the side that is ahead) cannot be modelled and is not scored; the shared bar means they always die together. This is the largest gap in the fight. Tesla Chain and the coil overload are not modelled because the single stationary entity cannot leave a coil (real: 4,375 to 5,625 Nature per second if a wight is dragged too far). Static Field (30 yd radius, 6 s, 500 mana plus equal Shadow, Feugen only) is an `aoe` of 400 around that one entity limited to mana users (`roles: [ranged, healer]`), who stand outside it and are scored on `staticHits`. War Stomp (`knockback`, radial, 15 yd, 900 scaled from 1,313, cadence unknown so every 14 s is an estimate) and Power Surge (`debuff` on the tank, `damageTakenMult` 1.6 for 10 s, about every 42 s, real +200% attack speed, cadence unknown) round it out. After each Magnetic Pull a 3 s `shield` with `roles: dps` scores attacks while the new tank rebuilds threat (`attacksIntoShield`): the real instruction is that DPS eases off for a moment (Warcraft Tavern), this is an engine stand-in with the exact length a guess. POLARITY SHIFT is scored movement. Phase 2 is one short phase per shift (first at 11.3 s, then every 30 s; DBM 25.9 to 35.7 s). Each shift is a 3 s cast placed at the end of the phase before it, so the charge lands on the phase boundary, together with the phase's marker and side expectations, and the player cannot see the new side before they carry the new charge (the first shift, 11 s into phase 8, stays where it is, because Thaddius is not yet awake in phase 7). It applies a `Negative Charge` or `Positive Charge` debuff (one debuff each, duration 26 s so the old charge is gone before the next one lands, instead of the real 60 s refreshed every shift). The two sides are camps at spots (`negCamp`, `posCamp`, `safeRadius` 15): `shockPos` and `shockNeg` are whole-room `aoe` pulses (1,800 every 5 s scaled from 2,000, first pulse 5 s after the charge lands, which is 8 s after the shift cast starts, honouring the real 5 s grace; the first shift's charge lands 3 s after its cast, then the pulses start 5 s later), each `conditional` on its own charge debuff and `safeSpots` on its own camp. Stand on the matching side and the pulse is out of line of sight and misses; stand on the other side and it hits for 1,800 and scores `wrongSide`. Every role's phase spots point to the matching camp and `playerAtSpotBy` checks you are there at the end, so the marker and the score both move you. The player's charge follows one fixed pseudo-random chart, identical on every seed (about half the shifts flip your side), rather than a per-seed coin flip: the engine has no way to make two debuff outcomes mutually exclusive from one random roll, and a fixed chart is also what lets the phase spots and expectations know the right side. The +10% damage per same-charge ally stacking that makes the real fight winnable is not modelled (no damage model for stacks of nearby players); nor is standing near the opposite charge dealing damage to others around you. The tank flips sides too and is scored the same way, running straight through him as the guides say. CHAIN LIGHTNING: a `debuff` random-target hit on the player (`playerChance` 0.35, 15 of 40 hit by the real spell, 1,900 scaled from 1,850 to 2,000) plus a separate tank-only tick of 1,400 every 7.5 s (real 5 to 10 s). BALL LIGHTNING: `aoe` 7,000 (the spell), 1 s cast, `conditional: meleeEmpty`, so any time the tank is not in melee range it fires: real behaviour. Thaddius is `boss.stationary` as the real one stands on his dais, and the tank must simply never leave melee, including when switching sides. Thaddius does not have a real enrage modelled mid-fight; BERSERK (+150% movement speed and +500% physical damage, DBM 300 s) is a `debuff` on the tank at 5:00 of phase 2 (`damageTakenMult` 1.3, 8 s listed) with the kill 6 seconds later: the real thing is a wipe and would make the validator's bot lose the tank, so it is shown but softened. Damage is scaled to a 10,000 HP tank, so a tank survives normal play but dies if the healer ignores a spike. Boss melee 1,000 per 2 s (the wiki's ~2,000 normal and 3,300 crush halved to the scale) plus Chain Lightning 1,400 every 7.5 s is about 690 damage per second on the tank in phase 2, against 200 passive healing with a player healer, so a healer who does nothing loses the tank in about 20 seconds. Two `aggroClimb` events in phase 2 are estimates for a stacked raid out-threating its tank (the wiki says warrior threat is shaky against ten-stacked DPS). Fidelity correction: normal encounter schedules no longer inject artificial DPS aggro pulls; threat changes through combat and actual encounter mechanics. Dedicated aggro drills retain their explicit stress events.

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Phase 1: hold your wight; every 21 seconds Magnetic Pull throws you across and wipes threat, so Taunt the moment you land. Phase 2: keep Thaddius in melee on your charge side and run through him when your charge flips. If nobody is in melee he nukes the raid.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Phase 1: hold your damage for a moment after every Magnetic Pull, then back on. Phase 2: stand on the side that matches your charge. If it flips, run through him, not around.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Phase 1: stay out of Static Field range and hold for a moment after every Magnetic Pull. Phase 2: your charge says which side you stand on. Check it every shift and move in time.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Phase 1: stay at max range, out of Static Field, and heal the tank through Power Surge. Phase 2: your charge says which side you stand on, same as everyone. The tank never stops taking hits.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

pullW.label: Magnetic Pull
pullW.toast: Magnetic Pull! You were thrown across. Taunt the wight!
pullW.tip: Magnetic Pull throws the tanks to the other platform and wipes threat. Taunt the wight you land next to.

pullE.label: Magnetic Pull
pullE.toast: Magnetic Pull! You were thrown across. Taunt the wight!
pullE.tip: Magnetic Pull throws the tanks to the other platform and wipes threat. Taunt the wight you land next to.

pullHold.label: Hold your damage
pullHold.toast: Magnetic Pull: DPS hold for three seconds while the new tank gets a hit in.
pullHold.tip: Three seconds while the new tank rebuilds threat on the wight.

warStomp.label: War Stomp
warStomp.tip: War Stomp hits everyone within 15 yards and knocks them back. Stay away from the platform edge.

staticField.label: Static Field
staticField.tip: Static Field burns the mana of everyone within 30 yards of Feugen and deals that much damage, every 6 seconds.

powerSurge.label: Power Surge
powerSurge.tip: Stalagg attacks three times as fast for 10 seconds. Tank cooldowns and heal early.

aggroClimb.label: A DPS pulls off the tank
aggroClimb.tip: Someone passed the tank on threat. Taunt.

relocate.label: Thaddius wakes
relocate.tip: Both wights are dead. The coils overload.

shiftNeg.label: Polarity Shift
shiftNeg.tip: Polarity Shift gave you a Negative Charge. Stand with the Negative side: opposite charges standing near each other take 2,000 Nature every 5 seconds.

shiftPos.label: Polarity Shift
shiftPos.tip: Polarity Shift gave you a Positive Charge. Stand with the Positive side: opposite charges standing near each other take 2,000 Nature every 5 seconds.

chargeNeg.label: Negative Charge
chargeNeg.tip: Polarity Shift gave you a Negative Charge. Stand with the Negative side: opposite charges standing near each other take 2,000 Nature every 5 seconds.

chargePos.label: Positive Charge
chargePos.tip: Polarity Shift gave you a Positive Charge. Stand with the Positive side: opposite charges standing near each other take 2,000 Nature every 5 seconds.

shockNeg.label: Polarity shock
shockNeg.tip: You are standing with the wrong side. Run to your own charge.

shockPos.label: Polarity shock
shockPos.tip: You are standing with the wrong side. Run to your own charge.

chainLightning.label: Chain Lightning
chainLightning.tip: Arcs through up to 15 of the raid. Spread only across your own stack.

chainTank.label: Chain Lightning
chainTank.tip: Chain Lightning hits the tank too.

ballLightning.label: Ball Lightning
ballLightning.tip: Thaddius with nobody in melee range nukes the raid for 7,000. Stay on him at every moment, even when your charge flips.

berserk.label: Berserk
berserk.tip: Five minutes in. This is the end whether he is dead or not.

expectations.label: Pick up your wight on the platform
expectations.tip: Tank it beside its coil. If a wight is dragged off the coil the raid dies.

expectations.label: Hold your damage for three seconds after every Magnetic Pull
expectations.tip: The new tank has nothing on the table. Give them a moment before you open up.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Stay outside Static Field
expectations.tip: Thirty yards from the wight or Static Field burns your mana and hits you for what it burned.

expectations.label: Healers stay at max range
expectations.tip: Static Field reaches 30 yards. Stay beyond it and still in range of the tank.

expectations.label: Stay out of Static Field
expectations.tip: Thirty yards around Feugen. Stand further out.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Magnetic Pull wipes threat and the wight can hit whoever it wants for a moment. Be ready for the swap.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Power Surge makes the tank fold. Heal ahead of it.

expectations.tip: Fifteen seconds to get down from your platform. Do not miss the jump.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

wrongSide.label: Polarity pulses on the wrong side
wrongSide.tip: Five seconds to get to your own side. Read the debuff the moment the cast ends.

staticHits.label: Static Fields you stood in
staticHits.tip: Stand more than 30 yards from Feugen.

attacksIntoShield.label: Attacks right after a Magnetic Pull
attacksIntoShield.tip: Three seconds while the new tank gets a hit in. Then go.

cues.notes: Taunt after every Magnetic Pull; DPS back on the boss after a pull; run to your charge after every Polarity Shift; heal through Chain Lightning and Power Surge.

list.label: Taunt when Thaddius turns on the raid
list.tip: Taunt as soon as the boss turns toward the raid.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

list.label: Back on him after the pull
list.tip: Three seconds for the new tank, then all of your damage.

list.label: Back on him after the pull
list.tip: Three seconds for the new tank, then all of your damage.

list.label: Heal through Power Surge
list.tip: Stalagg attacks three times as fast for 10 seconds. Keep him up.

list.label: Heal after Chain Lightning
list.tip: The tank just took it on top of a swing. Top him up.

list.label: Move, then back on him
list.tip: Five seconds to get to your side. Then damage.

list.label: Move, then back on him
list.tip: Five seconds to get to your side. Then damage.

drills.name: Magnetic Pull
drills.description: Every 12 seconds you are thrown across and the wight has an empty table. Taunt the moment you land.

drills.name: Polarity Shift
drills.description: Shifts come every 15 seconds. Run to your charge's side the moment the cast ends: you have five seconds before the first pulse.

drills.name: Run through him
drills.description: Your charge flips every 15 seconds. Move to your side, stay in melee.

drills.name: Heal through Chain Lightning
drills.description: Chain Lightning hits the tank every 6 seconds. Keep him up.

limitations: Stalagg and Feugen do not have separate health or resurrection rules. Charge assignments follow a fixed sequence.
